category_name: Returning a greeting to a disbeliever
title: Returning a greeting to a disbeliever - Hisn al-Muslim 109
arabic: إذَا سَلَّمَ عَلَيْكُمْ أَهْلُ الْكِتَابِ فَقُولُوا: وَعَلَيْكُمْ
translation: And upon you (when a disbeliever says 'Peace be upon you', respond with this).
tags: Returning a greeting to a disbeliever
